findings.title: Runtime Relation has no complete native registration/load transport

evidence.observation: Relations are created only after immutable parent/child Tables are built; TableBuilder has no relation method.
Relations appear inside canonical immutable table metadata, but no specified ABI/opcode registers the independent post-Build relation, selects it, or transmits the parent key for native FK expansion.
The mapping names only conceptual Relation.Load.

findings.impact: A future implementation must invent mutable metadata identities, an undisclosed native operation or managed relation construction to satisfy a currently declared public operation.
findings.requested_repair: Specify a closed source-bound relation registration and native load/query sequence (or an equally complete existing-operation sequence), with exact parent/child model identities, ordered key pairs, nullability/codec checks, key payload, bounded registry, owner retention/release, capability and failure semantics. Update DB-042, type policies and B09/B14 ownership.

findings.title: The Fluent surface cannot compare a nonnullable key expression with a nullable value-type foreign-key expression

evidence.observation: For Column<Parent,long> and Column<Child,long?>, the returned SqlExpression<long> and SqlExpression<long?> have no safe same-type comparison or nonnull-to-nullable lift.
The compiled join uses only nonnullable Enrollment.StudentId, so it does not cover this common optional-FK shape.

findings.impact: Ordinary strongly typed optional-FK joins and comparisons require a missing operation. Coalescing NULL to a sentinel is not semantically equivalent when the sentinel can match a real parent key.
findings.requested_repair: Add an explicit safe non-null-to-nullable expression lift or typed mixed-nullability comparison, with exact same-owner/configured-codec/native mapping and SQL three-valued semantics. Add a positive optional-FK join consumer and preserve rejection of nullable-to-nonnullable projections.
